title: FDA pulls the rug out from under Capricor's Duchenne therapy
hook: 你看見一個人穩穩站在一張黃色地毯上，手裡捧著一瓶藥。
bridge: 同一家公司接著去敲一堵石牆，敲了又敲，牆裡一點聲音也沒有。
p: BioSpace reported that the FDA rejected Capricor Therapeutics' Duchenne muscular dystrophy cell therapy, deramiocel, for a second time. The decision {0} the company: shares closed at $7.59 on Friday and were trading near $1.91 before the market opened on Monday. The FDA recommended a new randomized trial, which CEO Linda Marbán said would take about four years.

Marbán called the rejection a "giant shock" and said the agency {1} the company. She said Capricor sent 13 meeting requests between April and October, and none was granted. BioSpace reported that the FDA cited data integrity issues in its decision.
inText: pulled the rug out from under

words.term: pull the rug out from under
words.zh: 突然抽掉支撐，讓人措手不及
words.def: to suddenly take away the support or plans someone was counting on
words.mn: Capricor 捧著藥瓶，穩穩站在一張黃色地毯上，FDA 伸手一把把地毯抽走，人當場摔倒。腳下的地毯被抽掉，就是突然失去依靠。
words.ex: The investor backed out the night before closing and pulled the rug out from under the startup.
words.exZh: 投資人在交割前一晚反悔，讓這家新創措手不及。

words.def: to refuse to answer questions or cooperate, so nothing moves forward
words.mn: Capricor 的人一拳一拳敲在 FDA 的石牆（stone wall）上，敲了 13 次，牆裡零回應，紋風不動。敲不開的石牆，就是拒不回應。
words.ex: The company stonewalled reporters who asked about the data breach.
words.exZh: 公司對詢問資料外洩的記者一律推托不答。

quiz.q: Our biggest client cancelled at the last minute and ___ me.
opts: pulled the rug out from under
quiz.why: pull the rug out from under 是突然抽掉支撐、讓人措手不及。give a leg up 是助人一把，take under one's wing 是庇護、照顧新人。

quiz.q: For months the city council ___ reporters' requests for the budget records.
quiz.why: stonewall 是拒不回應、拖著不給。fast-tracked 是加快處理，filibuster 是在議會用冗長發言拖延表決，不是拒絕提供資料。
